name: NGC 5419 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5419, a giant elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5419-hubble
story: A giant elliptical galaxy with a double heart: two nuclei at its center hint that it may hold two supermassive black holes. Hubble returned to test whether a black hole here has been kicked out of place.

claims.text: NGC 5419 is a giant (core) elliptical galaxy
NGC 5419 shows a double nucleus and may host two supermassive black holes
Hubble program 15082 observed NGC 5419 as a candidate gravitationally recoiling supermassive black hole host
